title: Wild tiger population by country, 2022
geography: India, Russia, Indonesia, rest of world
notes: India: 3,682 (2022 national tiger estimate). Russia: ~750 Amur tigers. Indonesia: 371 (IUCN). Rest of world derived as the remainder of the 5,574 global 2022 total across the other tiger-range countries (Nepal, Bangladesh, Malaysia, Thailand, etc.). Approximate.
